sources.note: Only the general reconstruction 'Word stress in PNCV was most likely on the penultimate vowel. This is its position in almost all daughter languages for which phonological descriptions exist, where the historic final syllable is intact' (p. 16). Tasmate is not a sample language, only a lexical witness (Tasmate pani-ku, ta-lapa, mworu) and one of the five core Northwest Santo languages (p. 25). No Tasmate stress statement.
